You may be confused. It was the *House GOP* who refused to sign onto a bipartisan Senate agreement to fund DHS minus ICE/CBP.

It was the *Senate GOP* who refused to pass funding for DHS over and over and over again.

The GOP owns this shutdown.


Senate Republicans (@SenateGOP)

Senate Democrats walked away from a bipartisan bill to fund DHS. 

They demanded “reforms” that would end immigration enforcement altogether. 

Now, we’re going to fund ICE and CBP for years to come and Senator Schumer

Senate Republicans want to pour $140 billion into ICE and Border Patrol without putting any restraints on these rogue agencies’ rampant violence in our streets.

That is the last thing Americans want. Democrats are going to offer amendments to the budget to put the @SenateGOP on the record for their destructive policies.

Senate Republicans should not proceed with Warsh’s confirmation as these attacks on the Fed’s independence continue. Trump will put even more pressure on the Fed to serve his partisan agenda, and whoever serves as the next Chair must be able to withstand that immense political pressure.

Senate Democrats will not allow Donald Trump to inject more chaos into our economy by undermining the Fed.

Senate Democrats will force a fifth vote on our War Powers Resolution tomorrow, and we will continue to force votes every week this catastrophe continues.

Make no mistake: every time Senate Republicans continue voting against our resolution, they tie themselves more tightly to this failed war policy and this failed president.

The @SenateGOP budget: $70 billion for ICE. $0 to lower your costs.

It is Republicans’ own divisions and inability to govern that has led to the longest shutdown of an agency in American history.

Tomorrow, Senate Democrats will force a fifth vote on our War Powers Resolution. 
 
Senate Republicans cannot sit on the sidelines while our servicemembers are risking their lives on the frontlines.
 
We will continue putting them on the record until the war ends or until enough of them find the courage to vote with us to end this war.

I want to express my deepest and dearest sympathies for my friend, Senator Mark Warner, his wife Lisa, and the rest of their family as they mourn the terrible loss of their daughter Madison. The depth of this loss is unfathomable.

I am keeping the Warner family in my prayers and wishing them strength. May Madison’s memory be a blessing.


Mark Warner (@MarkWarner)
